text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, bestieee!!" Spurred on by the 
cheer from Daitaku Helios, who led 
alongside her, Mejiro Palmer shifts into 
high gear.

—Conquest of the Arima Kinen. The entire 
venue reverberates with chants of 
"Pal~mer!"

Mejiro Palmer, the rebel of the Mejiros. 
As a magnificent runaway, she etched her 
name into the memories of the crowd—

During the winner's interview, she pulled 
off the ultimate party-girl flex, then 
bolted off at full speed.
